parole.significato: a certain weight measure varying about 19 grams
parole.testo: From Middle Persian [Book Pahlavi needed] (styl /⁠stēr⁠/), from Ancient Greek στᾰτήρ (stătḗr).
Borrowed from Middle Persian equivalent to New Persian بَسْپَایَه (baspāya), بَسْپَایَک (baspāyak), from بَس (bas, “many”) + پَایَه (pāya, “foot”), calque of Ancient Greek πολυπόδιον (polupódion).
